desc_en: Ivory grip with inlaid dot/rosette pins, gold-koftgari pommel cap, wire-bound ferrule, plain steel cross guard; black tooled leather scabbard with silver lockets (pierced tops) and pierced gilt chape; gold lobed cartouche at forte

Wooden pistol grip with carved rosette pommel, silver floral cross guard with knob finials; dark scabbard with engraved silver locket, mounts and chape; slotted gold-decorated fullers, gold pear-shaped cartouche and 'amal' cartouche
All-steel hilt with silver-inlaid pistol grip, steel cross guard; broad curved blade with false edge, gold-koftgari forte panel with central lion/roundel medallion and inscriptions; no scabbard

Carved floral ivory grip with gold-koftgari pommel cap, wire-bound ferrule, plain steel guard; black leather scabbard with diamond-lattice tooling, embossed copper/silver lockets and long brown leather/copper chape; watered blade

Ivory grip painted/inlaid with orange-red floral scrolls, steel pommel cap, wire ferrule, steel cross guard; black tooled scabbard with leaf-shaped steel lockets and pinkish chape; engraved (non-gold) double cartouche; strong watered blade
Ivory grip with pins and gilt pommel cap, steel cross guard; black tooled scabbard with polished silver teardrop lockets and pierced silver chape; watered blade (no hilt close-up in set)

Fully silver repousse hilt with ball pommel and silver cross guard; red embroidered/velvet scabbard with large chased silver locket, mounts and scalloped chape; engraved gold-outlined cartouches, watered blade

Carved floral ivory grip with gold-koftgari pommel cap, plain steel guard; black leather scabbard with longitudinal grooved lines, steel lockets with pierced tops and pierced silver chape; watered blade

Straight double-fullered blade, carved ivory pistol grip with silver pommel cap, long steel cross guard with trefoil ends; scabbard fully covered in chased silver floral work with silver lockets; gold cartouche on blade

Steel hilt with horse-head quillon and horse-head knuckle-guard terminal; straight double-edged blade with gold-damascened medallions and wavy line; red embroidered scabbard with chased silver mounts and chape

Pinkish-orange stained ivory grip with white rosettes, gilt pommel cap, wire ferrule, steel guard; black tooled scabbard with plain steel locket; gold cartouches plus long gold inscription lines; watered blade (no overview in set)
Honey/amber-coloured ivory grip with gold-koftgari pommel, wire ferrule, steel guard with gold speckling; black tooled scabbard, silver lockets, gilt chape; three gold cartouches; watered blade
Ivory grip with dot-inlay pins and gilt pommel cap, plain steel guard; black floral-tooled scabbard with silver lockets and pierced silver chape; three black-ground cartouches with gold outlines
All-steel kard: faceted steel grip, straight single-edged blade with engraved floral forte panel
Carved pale-green jade hilt, pierced gilt collar with foliage, sharply curved double-edged blade; no scabbard
Carved floral ivory grip with pins and gold-koftgari pommel, steel cross guard with calligraphic medallion on dark ground; gold cartouches; watered blade (no overview in set)
Orange-red ivory/bone grip inlaid with small white floral pattern and pins, gilt pommel cap, steel guard; three gold cartouches incl. square magic grid; watered blade; no scabbard shown

Smooth white ivory grip, gilt pommel cap, steel diamond guard with gold-koftgari border; black floral-tooled scabbard with silver lockets and gilt calligraphic chape; two gold cartouches 'La fata illa Ali / la sayf illa Dhu'l-faqar' with dated maker cartouche

Carved floral ivory grip with gold-koftgari pommel, plain steel guard; black tooled scabbard with blackened lockets decorated with gold flowers and crowned suspension rings, pierced silver chape; strongly watered blade
Black horn grip with silver rosette rivets; long straight double-edged blade with offset fuller and stamped mark; red leather scabbard with silver repousse mounts and chape
Ivory grip with silver pommel cap, pierced gilt cross guard; gold inscription band along blade back and gold cartouches; black tooled scabbard with copper/gilt repousse locket and gilt chape

Ivory grip with dot-inlay pins and gold-koftgari pommel, long straight-quillon steel cross guard; black grooved/tooled scabbard with calligraphic steel lockets and gilt chape; two gold-outlined black cartouches ('Ali...', 'amal Muhammad...')

Qajar steel shield, gold-and-silver damascened; central sun-face boss and four rosette bosses on six-lobed panels engraved with seated courtly figures and musicians; outer band of cartouches with chiselled (pseudo-)inscriptions alternating with bird/animal roundels; brass rim. 340 = plain iron inside with central rivet and four boss rivets

Hide (buffalo/rhino) shield, translucent orange-brown, gilt sunburst rosette at centre and six gilt lotus-flower bosses on red felt washers; back with red felt cushion, rope/cord handles and iron rings

Steel shield with gold-line koftgari, sixteen-point radiating star/sunburst design, central sun-face boss and four rosette bosses; outer bands densely engraved with nasta'liq inscriptions and animal/hunting scrolls; back lined with red felt with four rings

Qajar steel kulah khud with mail aventail, engraved with seated figures/courtly scenes, gold koftgari cruciform panels, cartouche band with chiselled inscription round the rim, sliding nasal with heart-shaped terminal, two plume holders and central spike

Shamshir with pistol grip of carved bone/ivory (peach-toned, strapwork and quatrefoil arabesques) fixed by two brass pins, plain steel cross guard with ball finials, watered blade with two chiselled cartouches, tang chiselled 'Allah'; black relief-tooled leather scabbard with oval steel lockets and wooden(?) chape
Short-sleeved riveted mail shirt, open front closing with two leather-and-iron hook clasps, split/scalloped hem; displayed on mannequin with the figural kulah khud and an arm guard
Long mail shirt with elbow-length sleeves and tall standing mail collar, rust-brown patina, front slit
Short-sleeved mail shirt with leather-lined collar, front closing with three iron flower-shaped hook clasps
Long mail shirt with three-quarter sleeves, keyhole neck opening without collar, ragged hem
Qajar steel arm guard engraved with figural panels (seated musicians, princes, ladies) under gold-koftgari arches, cartouche with chiselled inscription; plain iron inside (413)

Shamshir with ivory grip and steel pommel cap, silver-and-gold koftgari cross guard, watered blade with one teardrop chiselled cartouche with gold outline; plain black leather scabbard with two oval koftgari lockets (floral, gold centre) and long koftgari chape

All-steel shamshir, engraved steel pistol grip and cross guard, blade with figural cartouche at forte, long interlaced-calligraphy panel and teardrop cartouche, slotted fuller; black tooled leather scabbard with steel lockets
Kard with straight single-edged watered blade and dark iron grip with gold-speckled koftgari; no scabbard
Kard with silver hilt and scabbard decorated with blue and green enamel (floral scrolls and inscription), bud-shaped chape finial, straight watered blade
